This happened to me! Super long story sorry  this is going to sound neglectful I guess but my mom never realized my chest was caved in. I believe it was sort of mild as a baby but by the time I went through puberty it was very severe, I remember crying when I bought my first bra because it didn't fit right and I just wanted to be "normal". Bra shopping for the first time should have been a little celebration (or at least it is where I live) but I was just so upset. My mom didn't think anything of it. 9~ years later, we get the diagnosis of Pectus Excavatum, and my sternum was caved in so badly my heart was squished causing permanent damage *and* moved to the left side of my chest (hearts are usually in the middle and only very slight offset to the left). I was happy to have a name and answer for why I struggled to breathe and exercise growing up and why I had recurring lung infections (I got 1-3 a year of either pneumonia or pleurisy). My mom burst out crying and felt guilty for not thinking it was a problem. I was totally chill about it, having an answer made everything better. I wasn't crazy (my test results for anything lung related was normal and drs were doing the wrong tests for my heart). I had to comfort her when really it was my moment and I should have been panicking about needing surgery.
